chosenApproach: Reuse existing platform Skia 2.6.2 and Reanimated 4.5.1 with a bounded one-shot event-driven native Canvas overlay subscribed to genuine game feedback events, retaining score and interaction authority. Enhance actual Jawo move/hit/collect avatar kinematics and Trudice correct-step restoration ring. Preserve web fallback unchanged; no new sound assets/native dependencies/backend. Also stop existing shared React Native atmospheric animation loops while native stage is unfocused, backgrounded, or Reduce Motion is on; preserve the unchanged web default.
selectionRationale: A cheap shared hardware-accelerated motion layer gives real gameplay reactions to all existing game stations without separate builds, touches or reward logic changes. Per-game native animations remain inside their existing deterministic state machines.
alternativeApproaches: Ship static world art only: rejected because it lacks gameplay-responsive motion.
Rewrite 39 game engines or add new Rive .riv assets without authored character rigs: rejected as an unsafe incomplete native rebuild.
Use existing Skia/Reanimated and add bounded gameplay-reactive visual enhancements: selected.
